Halloween Costume Party

Join Green Turtle Kava Bar for a thrilling Halloween Costume Party! Come dressed in your best costume and compete for a chance to win free tabs for the night. It’s the perfect way to celebrate Halloween with friends, family, great music, and spooky vibes. Enjoy the kava drinks, show off your creative costume, and be part of an unforgettable evening.

To make the night even more exciting, there will be special shots given out every hour. It’s the perfect opportunity to show off your spooky style, sip on kava, and join in on the themed party atmosphere.

Teams can compete in a fun, friendly environment, testing their knowledge across various topics. Whether you’re a trivia enthusiast or just looking for a lively evening out with friends, the mix of competition and delicious kava makes for an enjoyable night.
